title: Rick Ran a Stealth Intervention on Mr. Poopy Butthole — And Broke Him in One Line

cuts.voiceover_text: The couch guest has been there so long the family is tripping over top hats and buying his drugs. Summer, Beth, and Morty corner Jerry at breakfast. They want Mr. Poopy Butthole gone. Beth defends him. He is a family friend. Then a random dealer walks in asking about the cash he already fronted the yellow guy on the couch. Beth's face drops. She sends Morty to fetch Rick. The problem just became Rick's problem.

Morty finds Rick in the garage, already back from killing an alternate version of himself. The family drags him upstairs and pitches Robo Ghosts — a robot that scares people out of your house. Rick rejects it. Ten percent success rate, comedically and clinically. So Beth escalates. Fix it yourself, or Mr. Poopy Butthole moves down to the garage with you. Rick's smirk drops. He is now cornered by his own daughter.

Rick will not do this alone. He portals straight to Bird Person's place and grabs him mid-argument with his newly rescued daughter. Then he collects Squanchy. He calls it getting friends to help him talk to a friend. Summer calls it what it is. An intervention. Rick insists it is not, because Rick never runs an intervention. He runs whatever this is going to turn out to be.

Coffee shop would tip him off, so they take the target to a bar. Because if the venue has food, a bar is allowed. The place is literally called F#%K YOU! The waiters insult you on arrival. Mr. Poopy Butthole thinks it is a bonding trip. He does not know his three best friends are already on a plan.

They tell the staff it is his birthday. It is not his birthday. A paper hat lands on his head that reads DEADBEAT DAD. Poopy Butthole grins through it. He is drunk enough to accept a hat that calls him a deadbeat and treat it like a compliment. Rick watches. The plan is working.

Then Hugh Jackman walks in. Poopy Butthole insists they hosted the Oscars together and demands nobody call him Wolverine. Jackman recognizes nothing about him. Instead he invites the whole table back to his place, the Jacksack, for something he refuses to name. Bird Person warns them. Jackman parties without limits and it gets extreme. Challenge failed. They go.

At the cabin, Jackman monologues about firing his agent and never accepting other people's limitations. Poopy Butthole eats it up. He announces he is getting his ex-wife Amy back tonight. Bird Person tries to shut it down. Poopy Butthole calls him a fake friend. That is Rick's cue. He lands the line cold. You are a vampire, brother. You feed off other people's energy. You have been on my daughter's sofa for months.

Poopy Butthole's counter is a threat. If he leaves, the entire family dies. Rick asks why not, then. Because you are my friend. There it is — the whole leverage he was living on, said out loud. Jackman flips and screams at Rick for bossing the room. Rick calmly orders drinks to go. The intervention Rick swore he wasn't running just closed.

Outside on the sidewalk Rick finally admits it. He dragged the whole crew out because he did not want to talk to PB alone. They cue the boombox under Amy's window and go down with the ship on the ex-wife stunt too. It fails on cue. That was also part of the plan — let him crash publicly so he has nowhere left to hide.

Back at the Smith house, Beth walks in on Mr. Poopy Butthole passed out on the floor in a ring of empty bottles. Rick does not soften it. Do not high-road me. It is just as dishonest to play dumb about wearing out your welcome. Read the room. Poopy Butthole finally reads it. The hostage situation on the family sofa is over.
